summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters and at least three character classes. Enforcement persisted across a verified node restart.

Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and the policy remained enforced.

evidence.requirement: New passwords must be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes.
